title: Track Guide Oulton Park Fosters FF1600 iRacing

notes.braking: brake close to left banner, 75% pressure, trail brake
notes.line: cut curb, use grass before car bounces
notes.exit: throttle close to curb, ease in
notes.text: braking: brake close to left banner, 75% pressure, trail brake; line: cut curb, use grass before car bounces; exit: throttle close to curb, ease in; mistakes: wide exit if over-throttle
notes.snippet: start to break once I get close to the beginning of the banner here on the left once I get to that I go to about 75%
ends turn two is flat out but we want to be on the right side of the track for turn three we don't have to break for

notes.exit: throw car over curbing, avoid going too far
notes.text: exit: throw car over curbing, avoid going too far; mistakes: 1x if go too far
notes.snippet: to throw the car over the curbing just make sure you don't go too far lift as that will give you a 1x the goal is to

notes.braking: brake at left white line, 90% pressure
notes.line: ease off brake to inside curb, take lower part
notes.mistakes: brake twice if miss first time
notes.text: braking: brake at left white line, 90% pressure; line: ease off brake to inside curb, take lower part; exit: full throttle after curb; mistakes: brake twice if miss first time
notes.snippet: been on 90% the first time and then we want to ease off the brake all the way to the inside curb there's a lower part

notes.text: line: flat out; exit: flat out
notes.snippet: turn five is flat out just make sure to be smooth we are flat out all the way way up to turn 8 and turn 8 is a place

notes.braking: break once I get to this kink in the road here, 65% brake pressure
notes.line: ease off brake to first curb, stay close to second curb
notes.mistakes: overtaking attempts, going on throttle too early
notes.text: braking: break once I get to this kink in the road here, 65% brake pressure; line: ease off brake to first curb, stay close to second curb; exit: throttle after first curb; mistakes: overtaking attempts, going on throttle too early
notes.snippet: the second curb as well if you under stay away from it you'll gone on the throttle too early and if you hit it too

notes.braking: break just before third part of road, 90% brake pressure
notes.line: aim for emergency road on right
notes.mistakes: going off into grass, going on throttle too early
notes.text: braking: break just before third part of road, 90% brake pressure; line: aim for emergency road on right; exit: full throttle after emergency road; mistakes: going off into grass, going on throttle too early
notes.snippet: this third part of the road here I aim for about 90% breake pressure easing that off all the way to the emergency
